insert_permutation:
induction input with
| nil => simp [insert]
| cons head tail ih =>
  by_cases h : value ≤ head
  · simp [insert, h]
  · simp only [insert, h]
    exact (List.Perm.cons head ih).trans (List.Perm.swap value head tail)
insert_sorted:
revert ordered
induction input with
| nil => intro ordered; simp [insert]
| cons head tail ih =>
  intro ordered
  have hs := List.pairwise_cons.mp ordered
  by_cases h : value ≤ head
  · simp only [insert, h]
    apply List.pairwise_cons.mpr
    constructor
    · intro y hy
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with rfl | hy
      · exact h
      · exact Int.le_trans h (hs.1 y hy)
    · exact ordered
  · simp only [insert, h]
    apply List.pairwise_cons.mpr
    constructor
    · intro y hy
      have hy' := (insert_permutation value tail).mem_iff.mp hy
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy' with rfl | hy'
      · omega
      · exact hs.1 y hy'
    · exact ih hs.2
sort_permutation:
induction input with
| nil => simp [sort]
| cons head tail ih =>
  exact (insert_permutation head (sort tail)).trans (List.Perm.cons head ih)
sort_sorted:
induction input with
| nil => simp [sort]
| cons head tail ih => exact insert_sorted head (sort tail) ih
